method: Use the table of contents to locate chapter boundaries, then scan the chapter across all web pages to its next heading. Track scene changes and character locations before deciding whether each scene needs a full spatial audit. External narrative can be screened out only after checking for station-related remote evidence.
sequence_note: B2-051/052 already had REVIEWED_FULL_PAGE entries before this chapter filter was formalized; their scene classes are a retrospective context cross-check. B2-053 was first read before its chapter boundary was checked in the table of contents; its split was then verified. B2-054/055 were read across the full chapter after its heading and end page were identified. This package does not claim the filter was applied before prior reads.
